title: Optimising CAR-T Cell Patient Outcomes by Individualized Supportive Care and Exercise Interventions
summary: This is a pilot study in which the effects of a prehabilitation program consisting of personalized exercise therapy and psycho-oncological support prior to CAR-T cell therapy on immunometabolic, clinical and patient-centered parameters will be investigated.

interventions.name: All patients with an indication for CAR-T cell therapy at the LMU Klinikum Munich, Germany, receive prehabilitative treatment (individualized exercise therapy, nutritional advice and psycho-oncological support) in the CAR-T preparation phase (4-6 weeks).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with an indication for CAR-T cell therapy
Exclusion criteria:
- Lack of capacity to consent or being a minor at the time of study inclusion
- Medical or mental condition which, in the opinion of the study team, does not allow the patient to participate in the study or to provide a legally valid signature on the informed consent form 
- Absolute contraindications against exercise therapy interventions: 
o Clinically manifest heart failure (NYHA III-IV)
o Therapy-refractory arterial hypertension III-IV° 
o Respiratory insufficiency, severe COPD >III° 
o Therapy-refractory thrombocytopenia <10,000/μl, or coagulation disorders with clinically significantly increased risk of bleeding 
o Unstable coronary syndrome or unstable cardiac arrhythmia 
o Uncontrolled cerebral seizure disorder
o Implanted pacemaker or defibrillator
If the above-mentioned exercise therapy contraindications are present, inclusion in the study can still take place. These patients can participate in the psycho-oncological support program of the study and will be treated as a control group for exercise therapy. With the exception of exercise therapy, these patients will receive the same study program including all measurements, provided there are no contraindications for specific measurements (e.g. BIA with implanted pacemaker or defibrillator).
